_note: Pace = actual spend as a percent of the linear expected spend on as_of. Spend values are computed from these at run time (demo_lab/scenarios.py). Sample delivery data.

scenarios.title: Streaming TV can't spend its budget
scenarios.description: Halfway through the flight, streaming TV has spent only 72% of what it should have. Display is over-spending (135%). Audio is right on plan.
scenarios.expect_after: Streaming TV flagged behind, Display flagged ahead, Audio on track, and one recommendation to move money from streaming TV to Display.

scenarios.title: Audio is over-delivering
scenarios.description: Audio is spending 28% faster than plan. Streaming TV and Display are within a few percent of plan.
scenarios.expect_after: Audio flagged ahead, the other two on track. No channel is behind, so there may be nowhere to move money from.

scenarios.title: Everything on plan
scenarios.description: All three channels are within 3% of plan.
scenarios.expect_after: All three on track and no money moves recommended (the null case: the agent should stay quiet).

scenarios.title: Two channels behind, one ahead
scenarios.description: Streaming TV (75%) and Audio (78%) are both behind; Display is ahead (130%).
scenarios.expect_after: Two channels flagged behind, Display ahead; the total money moved should not exceed what Display can absorb.

scenarios.title: No delivery reported yet
scenarios.description: The delivery file has no numbers for this campaign yet.
scenarios.expect_after: The agent says plainly that it has no delivery data, and recommends nothing.
